newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-H&Q starts six chip companies.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-H&Q starts six chip companies.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist started coverage of several semiconductor companies on Tuesday, according to a market source.
-- Novellus Systems Inc and PRI Automation Inc were started with buy ratings, the source said.
-- Applied Materials Inc, KLA Instruments Corp, Integrated Process Equipment Corp and LAM Research Corp were started with hold ratings, the source said.

-- Novellus shares slipped 1/4 to 42-3/8 in early trading Tuesday. PRI shares fell 1-5/8 to 31-1/8, Applied Materials fell 3/8 to 27-1/4, KLA shares dropped 7/16 to 22-1/16, Lam shares lost 1/2 to 26-1/8 and Integrated Process shares fell 1/2 to 15-3/8.
